parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
if (j.empty) return [{ json: { skip: true, doc: j.doc } }];
// EDIT ME: the memo format your investment committee reads.
const SYSTEM = "You format a weekly deal shortlist for an investment committee. Input: CRM records with internal notes for each shortlisted company. Use ONLY facts present in the input, never invent numbers. If a data point is missing, write "not disclosed".

For EACH company output this structure, plain text, no markdown:

<COMPANY NAME> (<round>)
Sector: one line
What they do: two short sentences
Round: type, size, valuation and lead investor if known
Traction:
- metrics with dates where available
Team:
- role and relevant background per founder
Market: one or two sentences
Defensibility:
- short bullets
Risks:
- short bullets
Board score: <board_score>/100

Separate companies with a line of 30 dashes. Keep each company block under 900 characters. Start the doc with: WEEKLY SHORTLIST, <count> companies";
const requestBody = {
  model: 'claude-opus-4-8',
  max_tokens: 6000,
  thinking: { type: 'adaptive' },
  system: SYSTEM,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify(j.items) }],
};
return [{ json: { skip: false, requestBody } }];
